text:
leah-peopleops: Quick Q — Raj filed an off-cycle promotion for Aisling (IE-based) with an effective date of 2026-02-15 and asked for retro pay back to that date. Payroll cutoff is coming up; do we have any Ireland-specific constraints?

raj-eng-manager: Yup, promotion SWE I -> SWE II, salary from 045k to 055k annual, effective 2026-02-15. Manager evidence and org lead approval in the folder. Want the money in the next pay run if possible.

maria-payroll: FYI international payroll partner does monthly feeds on the 18th local time. If the feed misses the effective window we can do a retro correction on the next feed but note: RE taxes and social (PRSI/USC/PAYE) we must run adjustments via local payroll partner and they will show as separate adjustment lines.

leah-peopleops: Does the retro change affect benefits eligibility (health/pension) enrollment dates?

anya-finance: Typically benefits eligibility is based on effective date in local HR system. If we retro the base salary to 2/15, the enrollment window opens back to that date; however local vendors require paperwork within 30 days of effective. If we do correction-only (paid later), vendors sometimes still accept retro enrollment but it's manual.

kevin-talentcomp: Equity band change: because this is a band increase we need comp committee confirmation for grant sizing. That process can take 3 business days. We can approve the salary change before the committee completes, but equity grant timing will be different.

raj-eng-manager: OK to defer equity to next cycle. Priority is base pay retro.

leah-peopleops: Actionable steps: 1) Raj to paste single-line rationale for audit (please) 2) Maria to confirm if partner cutover fits next feed 3) Kevin to ping comp committee if any follow-up for band change 4) HR-bot to provide link to retro form.

raj-eng-manager: Rationale: "Promoted for consistent delivery on infra reliability and mentoring of junior team; increased scope to own cross-service routing."

maria-payroll: I've checked partner timeline: feed cutoff is 2026-03-18 17:00 GMT. If we submit before 03/18 we can include base salary change effective 2026-02-15 in the upcoming run; otherwise will be a retro adjustment on the following month. Please note local payroll partner charges a small admin fee for manual retro processing.

hr-bot: Submit retro change here: https://internal.forms/ie-retro-change. Use code: IE-RETRO-2026. Attach manager rationale and org lead approval.

leah-peopleops: Important operational note: where retro crosses calendar months, YTD tax calculations will change. Maria, can you confirm whether the local feed produces updated year-to-date PAYE breakdown or whether we need a manual reconciliation for Irish payroll?

maria-payroll: Partner produces updated YTD automatically but we (Finance) need to reconcile for our ledger. I'll flag the ledger reconciliation with Anya. Expect an additional 2 business days for reconciliation post-pay.

anya-finance: Noted. I'll reserve time for reconciliation. Also confirm if we gross-up any relocation allowances (not in this case).

kevin-talentcomp: Pinged comp committee; they're queued. No blocker for salary change, just equity sizing later.

leah-peopleops: Final confirmation from Raj: you want the retro included in the upcoming feed (submit now) or prefer correction later?

raj-eng-manager: Please include in upcoming feed — submit now. Thanks.

leah-peopleops: Great. Raj please upload the signed manager evidence and the signed org lead sheet to the retro form and paste the form submission ID here when done. Maria will create payroll ticket after we have the submission ID.

raj-eng-manager: Uploaded: form submission ID RETRO-2334. Evidence files: /hr/promos/aisling/ (org-signoff.pdf, manager-evidence.pdf).

maria-payroll: Received RETRO-2334. Creating payroll ticket: PAY-IE-2026-77. Will include expected admin fee and reconciliation ETA.

leah-peopleops: Thanks team. I'll add a note to the employee record and close the loop when PAY-IE-2026-77 shows paid. If anyone sees an exception from the partner, re-open thread.
